# Assessment Supplementary Documents

These documents provide architecture, dependency, service, data, configuration, and workflow context for the assessment.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture and component relationships. |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Declared NuGet dependencies, categories, and compatibility observations. |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Service catalog, MVC request contracts, and communication sequence. |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | Blob storage model, data ownership, and persistence patterns. |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Configuration sources, runtime/build profiles, properties, and secret handling. |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Gallery browsing, image upload, and deletion workflows. |
